Three explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr, Salman and Q 17:3).

499
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 499: 1: 26

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
499: 1:26. Sufyan, from Isa, from Mujahid, on His words
"descendants of those We carried with Noah": He said, it is a vocative: "O descendants of those whom We carried with Noah" (verse 3).
العربية
499: 1: 26 سفيان عَنْ عِيسَى عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ ذُرِّيَّةَ مَنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نوح قَالَ هُمْ نِدَاءٌ يَا ذُرِّيَةَ من حملنا مع نوح (الآية 3) .

14

“Say, call upon those you claim besides Him; they have no power to…”

Two explanations transmitted from Abu Mamar (Q 17:56).

523
Explanation from Abu Mamar No. 523: 25: 5

Abu Mamar

English
Transmission wording
523: 25:5. Sufyan, from al-Amash, from Ibrahim, from Abu Mamar, who said:
Some people used to worship the jinn. Those [jinn] became Muslim, while these remained in their worship. So there was revealed: "Say, call upon those you claim besides Him; they have no power to remove harm from you or to change it. Those whom they invoke themselves seek the means of access to their Lord" (verse 56).
العربية
523: 25: 5 سفيان عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ قَالَ كَانَ أُنَاسٌ يَعْبُدُونَ الْجِنَّ فَأَسْلَمَ أُولَئِكَ وَبَقِيَ هَؤُلَاءِ عَلَى عِبَادَتِهِمْ فَنَزَلَتْ قُلِ ادْعُوا الَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُمْ مِنْ دُونِهِ فَلا يَمْلِكُونَ كَشْفَ الضُّرِّ عَنْكُمْ وَلا تَحْوِيلا. أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ يبتغون الى ربهم الوسيلة (الآية 56) .
